description: The bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model when optimizations are applied, comparing the performance of the NESAC ft model and the SESHA ft model across various optimizations. The vertical axis lists the optimizations applied, which include Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The horizontal axis represents the difference in average WER from Whisper large, with values ranging from 0.000 to 0.0034. The NESAC ft model is represented by orange bars, while the SESHA ft model is represented by green bars. The chart shows that for all optimizations, the NESAC ft model generally has a lower WER difference compared to the SESHA ft model, indicating better performance. The optimizations are sorted in descending order of WER difference, with 'Normalised' having the highest WER difference and 'Dates' having the lowest. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on the bars.
